🇲🇽🏭 <u>MEXICO SAYS NO: WASHINGTON WANTED 50% OF NORTH AMERICAN AUTO PARTS MADE IN THE USA</u>

In the T-MEC review, the US pushed to force 50% US-made content into North American vehicles — which would have raised the total regional threshold to 82% and gutted an industry that is 4.5% of Mexico's GDP and nearly a third of its manufacturing exports. Mexico refused. Sheinbaum's line held: the treaty stays in force, and renewal only happens by three-way agreement — not by Trump's ultimatum.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>THE STATE WARNS: SCAMMERS ARE POSING AS BIENESTAR TO ROB THE POOR</u>

Mexico's Bienestar ministry issued a public alert: fraudsters are calling and texting welfare recipients pretending to be the Secretaría de Bienestar or Banco del Bienestar to steal their banking data. Official word — "any communication requesting confidential data on behalf of Bienestar is an attempt at deception." Social programs never ask for bank details by phone or text. The welfare state defending the people it serves.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>SISTER OF PEÑA NIETO'S PEMEX BOSS ARRESTED OVER THE $200M FERTILIZER SCAM</u>

Gilda Lozoya — sister of ex-Pemex director Emilio Lozoya — was detained at Mexico City's airport over Agronitrogenados, the rusted-out plant Pemex bought for over $200 million during Peña Nieto's term. Prosecutors say she took at least five transfers worth millions from Alonso Ancira's network in 2012, acting as a front. Sheinbaum: this is not political persecution — the FGR arrest warrant predates this government.

🇲🇽🛡️ <u>TELCEL, AT&T AND MOVISTAR ORDERED TO DESTROY YOUR BIOMETRIC DATA</u>

Under Mexico's mobile-line registration rules, carriers — Telcel alone holds nearly 60% of the market — must destroy the facial photos and fingerprints they collect once your line is linked to your CURP. The state set the rule; the pressure is now on the companies to prove they're actually deleting it, not quietly hoarding it. Digital sovereignty means the citizen owns their body — not the telecom.

🇲🇽🏥 <u>MEXICO'S PUBLIC HEALTH SYSTEM IS NOW DOING ROBOTIC SURGERY — FOR PEOPLE WITH NO INSURANCE</u>

IMSS-Bienestar just carried out its 10th robotic operation on uninsured patients at the Ixtapaluca high-specialty hospital, using Versius surgical robots — less bleeding, less pain, faster recovery. Six robots are being deployed (Mérida, Estado de México, CDMX, with Cancún and Culiacán next), aiming for 400 interventions this year. Technology the old neoliberal system reserved for private clinics, now free at the point of care.

📸 Mañanera del Pueblo — Morelia, Michoacán · 3 de julio de 2026

🔥🇲🇽 Emilio Lozoya's sister arrested at Mexico City airport. The Agronitrogenados fraud case is still moving. "There is evidence of her participation in the fraud." — President Claudia Sheinbaum — Mañanera, July 3, 2026 Gilda Lozoya, sister of former Pemex director Emilio Lozoya, was detained on an outstanding arrest warrant tied to the Agronitrogenados case — the overpriced fertilizer-plant deal from the Peña Nieto years. García Harfuch stressed it followed a judicial order, not a political one. No impunity by surname.

🇲🇽🏭 Mexico is turning its avocado into protected national property: a Geographic Indication for 40,000 growers and 150,000 jobs. "The Geographic Indication of the Avocado adds value for more than 40,000 producers and more than 150,000 jobs." — Ximena Escobedo, Deputy Secretary — Mañanera, July 3, 2026 A Geographic Indication legally ties a product's name to its origin — the same tool that protects Champagne, Tequila and Colombian coffee. Applied to Michoacán's avocado, it keeps the value of a global export in the hands of the people who grow it. Economic sovereignty in practice.
